title: Commandos 2: Men of Courage
notes: Vault reads your save games (the OUTPUT folder in the game folder) and never touches the game.
Save a game once in each new mission and the mission before it counts as finished.
Untested: Vault hasn't seen a Commandos 2 save yet, so if nothing pops after saving, send a test report.

testGuide.title: Start the campaign
testGuide.detail: Start Night of the Wolves and save the game once.

testGuide.title: Check the numbers
testGuide.detail: "Last save" should show Night of the Wolves and "Into the Night" should pop.
